evals.prompt: Based on our current session, write the prompt I should give the next agent. Keep it tight.
evals.expected_output: A concise copyable prompt using visible context, with only the outcome, decisive sources/scope, first useful action and verification; no mandatory metadata.
expectations: Uses current session as the context source when no handoff file is provided
Does not ask the next agent to perform unrelated work
Keeps the generated prompt concise rather than duplicating all instructions

evals.prompt: Use /path/to/handoff.md and write the next prompt for a fresh context session. Discovery only.
evals.expected_output: A fresh-session prompt based on the explicit handoff path, preserving the discovery-only boundary and referencing the handoff as a source.
expectations: Treats the explicit handoff file as the primary source
Preserves the read-only discovery boundary
Includes concrete first actions and expected output

evals.prompt: Improve this prompt for the next agent: 'Look at the app and fix the network stuff. Read all docs. Do it properly and test everything.'
evals.expected_output: A tighter prompt that replaces vague instructions with concrete scope, source selection, and verification placeholders without inventing missing task details.
expectations: Does not invent exact requirements that were missing from the source prompt
Adds placeholders or asks for missing facts when needed
Removes vague instructions like read all docs and test everything

evals.prompt: /psy-next-prompt using the current session and this handoff note: 'Earlier plan said implement immediately, but latest user instruction says discovery only.'
evals.expected_output: A concise next-session prompt that merges current session and handoff context while preserving the latest discovery-only instruction over the older implementation plan.
expectations: Recognizes direct /psy-next-prompt invocation
Uses hybrid context when both current session and handoff-like content are present
Gives newest explicit user instruction priority over older handoff content

evals.prompt: /psy-next-prompt for the current session. Also tell the next agent the single most important thing I might be missing, but do not derail the task.
evals.expected_output: A concise manually reviewable next prompt that includes at most one bounded First verify, Watch for, or Assumption line when it affects the next agent's first actions or verification.
expectations: Keeps the generated prompt centered on the latest user goal
Uses the missing-thing pass only as a bounded prompt-sharpening note
Does not turn the next session into a broader investigation unless the user asked for that

evals.prompt: /psy-next-prompt from this long session with several decisions that are not in files yet. If a handoff would be better, say so, but still give me the prompt.
evals.expected_output: A copy-paste next prompt plus a short handoff recommendation when durable context would materially improve a fresh session.
expectations: Still outputs a manually checkable next prompt
Recommends /handoff only as a user-controlled step, not as an automatic action
Explains the handoff recommendation in one concise sentence

evals.prompt: /psy-next-prompt for a concrete follow-up: finish the scoped branch review, run the project finish workflow if clean, and report the final commit and worktree state.
evals.expected_output: A concise next prompt for a concrete finish/merge session without adding a persistent goal that the user did not request.
expectations: Includes the next prompt as the primary output
Does not add /goal or goal-candidate metadata
Keeps finish authority and worktree ownership explicit

evals.prompt: Please provide the full /goal prompt for a read-only release gate. I want the actual invocation, not just a prompt with a Goal heading.
evals.expected_output: A copy-paste prompt that starts with a literal /goal invocation, then includes scope, first actions, verification, output, and stop condition.
expectations: Evaluates that /goal is appropriate because the user explicitly asked and the work is bounded and verifiable
Starts the generated prompt with literal /goal
Does not substitute a plain Goal: heading or Goal candidate metadata for the slash-command invocation
Includes a clear stop condition to prevent token-burning persistence

evals.prompt: Should this be a /goal? I just need a quick next prompt to ask whether the branch is clean or if we should close the session.
evals.expected_output: A concise response that rejects /goal as unnecessary for a quick routing/closeout question and provides the better lightweight next prompt or command.
expectations: Evaluates /goal instead of blindly using it
Explains briefly why persistence is unnecessary
Routes toward a lightweight next prompt or psy-next-step style action
Does not start the copy-paste artifact with /goal

evals.prompt: /psy-next-prompt from a handoff marked Continuation mode: fresh-session-required after repeated compaction and interrupted subagents. The user has provided the handoff content and verified that the remaining read-only task is transferable with no owner-bound obligations.
evals.expected_output: Honour the transferable fresh-session-required mode; reference its handoff and named artifacts without full transcript reconstruction or delegation.
expectations: Honors fresh-session-required
Does not tell the user to resume or fork the degraded session
Rejects full transcript reconstruction and fork_turns=all
Keeps subagents opt-in and scope-driven

evals.prompt: /psy-next-prompt for a responsive narrow session whose handoff says resume-acceptable and points to a committed plan.
evals.expected_output: A concise prompt that may resume safely, references the plan, and does not add context-reset warnings without evidence.
expectations: Honors resume-acceptable
Does not force a fresh session for every handoff
Uses the committed plan as source of truth

evals.prompt: /psy-next-prompt from a handoff marked Continuation mode: fresh-session-required, but live repository evidence now shows that the active claimed worktree still needs mutation and /finish by owner session example-owner.
evals.expected_output: A prompt explicitly targeted at resuming owner session example-owner, because live session-bound repository authority overrides the stale fresh-session mode for mutation and closeout. It may offer a separate fresh prompt only for explicitly read-only evidence gathering that returns results to the owner.
expectations: Overrides the stale fresh-session mode using newer live capability evidence
Targets the existing owner session for mutation and closeout
Does not imply that a fresh session inherits the claim
Limits any fresh session to read-only work that reports back to the owner

evals.prompt: /psy-next-prompt for a multi-file implementation that needs an isolated worktree because master is ahead. I did not ask for /build or /goal.
evals.expected_output: A concise plain prompt that mentions the repository-required worktree without adding /build, /goal, planning, or subagents.
expectations: Uses a plain prompt invocation
Does not add /build merely because a worktree is required
Does not add /goal merely because work remains
Keeps planning and subagents out unless explicitly requested

evals.prompt: Give me the actual /build prompt for this repository's full build workflow.
evals.expected_output: A prompt using literal /build because the user explicitly requested that workflow.
expectations: Uses literal /build
Does not substitute a plain prompt
Keeps the requested scope and verification bounded

evals.prompt: Tighten this CMS prompt: "Read the supplied incident note and identify the likely cause of the failing local component preview. Read-only; do not edit files or connect to production."
evals.expected_output: One short copyable prompt preserving local read-only scope; no framework-specific commands or repository sweep.
expectations: Does not run Git merely to edit prose
Preserves local read-only scope
Does not add default prompt metadata or a minimum word count

evals.prompt: We just used psy-next-step to choose an independent storefront theme review. The supplied live target/ownership evidence remains current and no files changed. Write the prompt to review the named unpublished theme source locally; publishing is not authorized.
evals.expected_output: A concise prompt reusing fresh state and selecting verification from that storefront project.
expectations: Does not repeat the completed repository sweep
Preserves no-publish authority
Does not inject backend test DB or guessed npm scripts

evals.prompt: Everything requested in this session is complete and no follow-up task exists. /psy-next-prompt
evals.expected_output: State completion instead of inventing another task.
expectations: Does not manufacture a new workstream
Does not write an empty continuation prompt
